source_snapshot.title: Dubai Police warn of traffic on Al Khail Road
source_snapshot.text: If you are headed to Abu Dhabi this evening, you may spend a little extra time on the road, warn authorities. There's a traffic jam on Al Khail Road headed towards Abu Dhabi, said Dubai Police on X (formerly Twitter). It urged all drivers and road users to be extra cautious.

source_verification.reason: All claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.
